reelection.rule: Rule: end of the current class term in legislators-current.yaml. Class 3 ends 2029-01-03. The November before that January 3 end is November 2028. The file does not store the election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 Senate votes, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 22. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Democratic majority could be computed, 38 (95%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 44 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

finance.disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
finance.cycle_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2029-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2028.
finance.scope_note: Figures are committee receipts and itemized Schedule A for this two-year cycle only. This is not career fundraising. Schedule E outside spending is not included.
finance.error: OpenFEC has no Schedule A data for the 2028 two-year cycle. OpenFEC returned HTTP 404: two_year_transaction_period not found. Data exists for two_year_transaction_periods between 1976 and 2026. No receipts from another cycle are substituted.

lobbying_summary.line: Lobbying filings mention 1 of the 5 listed bills checked.
lobbying_summary.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.

running.label: Candidates who filed with the FEC for this seat. Filing is not the same as being on the ballot. Primary results and ballot access are not shown.
running.year_rule: Senate filings use the two-year cycle of the next election. the current term ends 2029-01-03, so the preceding November election is 2028.
incumbent_notes: Ron Wyden has a 2028 filing for this seat (FEC S6OR00110, FEC lists: Incumbent). Not counted below.

donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. Employer means where the donor works, not that the company gave money; corporations can't give directly to campaigns. Industry groups use simple keyword rules and may misclassify some donors.
donor_industry.cycle_rule: The current term began 2023-01-03, so the most recent completed election for this seat was in 2022 (FEC two-year cycle 2022).
donor_industry.cycle_note: Fallback cycle: these figures are from the 2022 two-year cycle (most recent completed election), not the current 2028 cycle. The 2028 cycle has no itemized donors yet.

cycle_fields.calendar_period_note: This seat reports toward the 2028 election. Money dated 2025–2026 is filed under the 2026 FEC period and is not shown on this card yet.

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.
stands_for.scope: Senate votes 1–262 of the 119th Congress, session 2 (262 votes, January 5, 2026 to November 12, 2026), from the Senate LIS.
stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.
stands_for.factual_flag: Not yet summarized: this line is built only from the official vote question and the bill's official title.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
RFK Jr. will be remembered as the HHS Secretary that lost America’s measles eradication status.

Under his leadership, we have witnessed the unraveling of decades of lifesaving science and innovation, and America’s children have paid the price.

It’s time to hold him accountable. https://t.co/MsEYWkTdPD
I was asked about my thoughts on the current senate leadership race: https://t.co/pT4SEZ5NWx

RFK Jr. will be held accountable for the children who have died on his watch.

He has sowed lies and misinformation about lifesaving vaccines for far too long.

Families are paying a terrible price for his disastrous agenda.

My dad escaped Nazi Germany during World War Two. He later proudly served in the U.S. Army.

I’m grateful for all those who, like my dad, bravely answered the call to serve. 

Happy Veterans Day to all our veterans, here at home and overseas! We honor you today and every day.

Pete Hegseth dragged us into another endless war in the Middle East, weakened our military, and is responsible for war crimes. 

The only thing he’s achieved is making our country less safe. 

And the Republicans in Congress just voted to keep him in office.

Today marks 100 days of the Trump administration denying legal assistance to 20,000 unaccompanied immigrant children. One of my top priorities as incoming Finance Committee Chair will be accountability for everyone that put these kids in harm’s way.

My Epstein investigation revealed that Jeffrey Epstein used proceeds from so-called “tax planning” to fund his sex crimes.

That money flowed through Wall Street banks and despite numerous warning signs, bankers looked the other way.

As Chairman of the Finance Committee, I'll https://t.co/ToKI6dEH8t

RFK Jr. has a been a disaster for America's public health.

He has spread misinformation and overseen the largest measles outbreak in decades. Children are sick and dying because of it.

He’s going to answer for it in January. https://t.co/q1pWiaWsx9

An excellent and timely new documentary about an iconic Oregonian who stunned election observers back in his day.
https://t.co/XghNpJ0ZkR
Subpoenas.

Proud to stand this #ElectionDay at @Portland_State with @ORSecretaryRead @AGDanRayfield & PSU president Ann Cudd to urge all Oregonians to exercise their vote.

Our state’s election system is the gold standard & I will stay vigilant to make sure there’s no interference with it. https://t.co/rVAQaLhUrV

Democracy, reproductive freedom, health care, inflation, tariffs, ICE, LGBTQ+ rights and so much more are all on the ballot today.

Oregon, if you haven’t already, get out and vote! There’s too much at stake for you to sit this one out.

posts.text:
Always inspired by the deep faith, fellowship & history of the congregation at Bethel AME Church here in Portland. 

Grateful to join the community for worship yesterday to reflect, recharge, and recommit to our shared work for justice and opportunity across Oregon. https://t.co/ywzRV7IzYb

I condemn the continued settler violence in the West Bank against Palestinian farmers, journalists, and rabbis. The Israeli government must uphold its responsibility to protect farmers’ access and ensure their safety. https://t.co/38cC7GsEMb

The Trail Blazers beating the Lakers tonight in LA is a nice early-season win. 

Obviously lots & lots of season left here in #RipCity 

But this team with Dame, Ja & Deni has the makings to make noise in the NBA.

Great day here at @Portland_State with @SenJeffMerkley & @RepBonamici to learn how the school & students will use the $2 million federal investment we worked to secure for semiconductor & nanotechnology research & training. https://t.co/k8ycNhTjCw

Met today in Portland with Oregon @MomsDemand to share ideas for common-sense solutions that reduce the risks of more school shootings like the one at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend. https://t.co/EHt71yRZcB

Recreation & enjoying public lands are in our DNA as Oregonians. 

That’s why I really enjoyed last week’s Outdoor Recreation Summit in Ashland to share ideas with great allies like @TravelOregon  @ORStateParks @or_trails & more about how best to protect our natural treasures. https://t.co/kBJ57Cu7ND

Amazing conversation with students at Phoenix HS today here in Southern Oregon about youth mental health.

Huge thanks to these teenagers for their honest thoughts.

Let’s work together to reimagine youth mental health in America. https://t.co/P1z2Y269va

Huge praise to the city of Newport for working together to protect what makes their Oregon Coast city such a special place.

A great example for the rest of America about how to stand up to ICE bullying. https://t.co/XlMg0UDkEe

Impressed by all the fresh & forward-thinking ideas I heard yesterday from @SOUAshland officials + partners & advocates about the vitality plan for the school’s long-term future.
 
Bottom line, this university is a vital piece of the Rogue Valley. https://t.co/5un5EBFeXI
So heartened to see how the Bend community has pulled together during this impossible tragedy. #BendStrong https://t.co/GFhOYbjh6I

Met this morning in Bend with @Lines_for_Life & many other Oregonians working 24-7 to reduce suicide rates in our state. 

With allies like these health care heroes, we can — and must — make mental health just as big a priority as physical health when reimagining health care. https://t.co/53e7aKXWWb

My heart is with the victims of today’s shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School and their loved ones now facing the consequences of another school shooting in America. Once again we must ask how many schools must be shot up before Republicans agree to act to curb gun violence. https://t.co/TJRO5AvkbZ

No company should be able to target you using your personal data, including the sensitive data people share with ChatGPT.  The privacy harms are enormous.

Congress needs to pass my bill to ban surveillance ads—including targeted ads by chatbots. https://t.co/p3DwzTekQg

Register to vote at the link below!

https://t.co/1ViP4plvdu

Hey Oregon: don't forget today is the last day to register before some crucial elections happening on November 3rd!

Go vote!
Tough result for @oregonfootball today but always a great atmosphere here at Autzen Stadium. #GoDucks https://t.co/OuQMTl7dVu

So let me get this straight:

Trump started a war with Iran that drove up diesel prices.

NOW he's rewarding Putin with a windfall agreement that won't even lower prices. https://t.co/yr1a2zq1mh

Mounting calls to my office about the exodus of Medicare Advantage plans statewide underscore the urgent need to pass #Medicare4All nationwide.
 
The time is now for all Americans to have a health care guarantee that’s affordable.

https://t.co/HS9vH7YruT

Glad the teamwork with @SenJeffMerkley, @RepBonamici, @RepCyrusJavadi & the community to secure $64 million for the south Tillamook Jetty brought the results we celebrated yesterday. 

The rocks are here. And the North Coast is even more ready to roll for safer navigation. https://t.co/Wj4Uc1eEi7

I'm tracking the outrageous & unconscionable surge in ICE activity & arrests in Oregon.
 
ICE’s answers only raise more questions & I’ll never stop pressing for fair treatment of immigrants & accountability from ICE.
 
My office is here to help.
https://t.co/6tXStF7N7Z
Did anyone see that coming or https://t.co/JBTvrUgzcw

Trump said he'd give families peace and affordability.

Instead, he gave us another quagmire war in the Middle East that made gas, groceries and everything else more expensive. https://t.co/mXP02i4GYW

Impressed by how the Family Peace Center of Washington County gets families & children the resources they need. 

Glad to work with @SenJeffMerkley and @RepBonamici to secure federal investment for its community center in the work to ensure victims of abuse are supported. https://t.co/TbYQn3hgCR

Great to sit down yesterday with friends at @APANOActionFund over a tasty dim sum lunch at @ExcellentCuisin in SE Portland for a substantive conversation covering immigration, housing & more. https://t.co/UMUELX4pZg

What a beautiful day in Oregon City
to walk downtown this week with Mayor Denyse McGriff & visit with small business owners and residents. 

With the Willamette River as a gorgeous backdrop, we heard & saw this community’s very best. https://t.co/XfnsBx9NdP

Thanks to all the students at McDaniel HS in east Portland today who shared the mental heallth challenges they & their friends face. 

Their thoughtful accounts will help reimagine U.S. health care so mental health for all ages is treated just as seriously as physical health. https://t.co/jtgwyP04Xv

Troubling reports keep coming my way from Oregon attorneys who can’t even reach their clients at the ICE facility in SW Portland. 

That denial of immigrants’ due process rights is unacceptable & unconstitutional.

Trump and Republicans canceling new energy projects as energy costs are already climbing is a level of economic self-sabotage so staggering it makes your head spin. 
https://t.co/5ZeTIj7GDZ

Nobody in America should be subject to warrantless surveillance by Flock cameras that track your movements from here in Clackamas County all across Oregon. 

With great allies like @chotzen4oregon & Jessica Maravilla of  @ACLU_OR, we will stop these weapons of mass inspection. https://t.co/NgraMn4FE4

A total blast at the annual Greek Festival this weekend in NE Portland.

Great community vibe, tasty food & wonderful reunions with long-time friends like Father Paul and so many others. https://t.co/9ZwjlvgMxQ

On a gorgeous fall Sunday here in Portland with a full slate of NFL games on TV, thousands & thousands of @trailblazers fans poured yesterday into the Moda Center to watch a preseason FanFest scrimmage. 

#RipCity proves once again it’s the NBA’s best fan base. https://t.co/jSIC76llHA
Few better ways to enjoy a beautiful fall Sunday morning than to cheer on all these impressive @PDXMarathon runners racing today through my neighborhood here in Portland. https://t.co/4DpFC668oQ

Great to be at El Tigre Fest yesterday in @TigardOR  to celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month with friends like Mayor Hu. 

I know firsthand how immigrants enrich Oregon's culture, power our economy, and strengthen our state. 

That’s why I’ll always stand up for immigrant families. https://t.co/VNBkzPHFum

Nothing beats the energy with @PDXPrideNW at Portland’s Pride Plaza. Terrific seeing so many people come together to celebrate community this weekend. Oregon will always be a place where love wins and everyone is free to live authentically. https://t.co/CqWIXjdoyV
Can’t wait for the probes to exonerate Joe McCarthy & Al Capone. https://t.co/KNkE8xqSdf

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.
financial_disclosures.note: Senate financial disclosures are filed through efd.senate.gov, a different system from the House Clerk index used here. Senate filings are not listed yet.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
